title: Mi2000 TICI Follow-up
summary:
This Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF) investigation aims to further collect evidence on safety and performance of the Mi2000 TICI. This PMCF investigation will collect retrospective and prospective clinical data from the use of the Mi2000 TICI and related devices.

This PMCF investigation is performed on a new cochlear implant system, which was previously studied in two pre-market clinical investigations with limited follow-up duration. The purpose of the current clinical investigation is to collect further evidence by collecting clinical data on the use of the Mi2000 TICI.

The Mi2000 TICI is a state-of-the-art cochlear implant, designed to be totally implantable, indicated to treat severe to profound hearing loss, asymmetric hearing loss and single-sided deafness.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Recipient of an Mi2000 TICI in one of the pre-market studies
* Signed and dated informed consent before the start of any study-specific procedure

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lack of compliance with any inclusion criterion
* Anything that, in the opinion of the Investigator, would

  * place the subject at increased risk
  * preclude the subject's full compliance with or completion of the study
